main.description: Request a credential for reading data across a space. Depending on the space's policy, a delegation token and/or client attestation may be required. Implemented by the space host.

credentialKid.description: P-256 did:key that the credential is bound to.

delegationToken.description: Delegation token from getDelegationToken, identifying the user.

clientAttestation.description: Client attestation JWT, identifying the app.

errors.name: SpaceNotFound
errors.description: May also be returned in place of UserNotAuthorized, to avoid revealing that the space exists.

errors.name: UserNotAuthorized
errors.description: The user is not authorized to access the space.

errors.name: AppNotAuthorized
errors.description: The app is not authorized to access the space.

errors.name: NotAuthorized
errors.description: Generic refusal. May be returned in place of UserNotAuthorized or AppNotAuthorized.
